contract.phase_delay: The rebuild derives an initial delay of 0x0A from the phase counter, decrements it while the wait gate is clear, and reloads 0x3C after each completed phase.
contract.wait_gate: The rebuild sets the gate before servicing, clears it after the Z80 status-bit-4 completion path, and tests it to decide whether the phase delay may advance.
contract.phase_pending: The rebuild sets the marker when the phase delay expires, tests it to enter finalization, and clears it after finalization.

conclusion: The three neighboring bytes form a complete scene-resource rebuild phase-control contract with no accesses outside SceneResource_RebuildAfterInteraction.
